sentences.englishText: Plaza Shopping Centre is located in the centre of Harlow next to the South Coach station.
sentences.turkishText: Plaza Alışveriş Merkezi, Güney Otogarı'nın hemen yanında Harlow'un merkezinde yer almaktadır.

sentences.englishText: It offers free parking for twelve thousand cars and easy access for all visitors arriving by vehicle.
sentences.turkishText: On iki bin araç için ücretsiz otopark ve araçla gelen tüm ziyaretçiler için kolay erişim sunar.

sentences.englishText: The centre is open until late at night, and the Picnic department is also open on Sundays.
sentences.turkishText: Merkez gece geç saatlere kadar açıktır ve Piknik bölümü Pazar günleri de açıktır.

enrichment.summary: Plaza Shopping Centre is located in the centre of Harlow next to the South Coach station. It offers free parking for twelve thousand cars and easy access for all visitors arriving by vehicle.
